name: Queen of Hoxton
summary: A bar and nightclub on Curtain Road in Shoreditch that first opened in 2009. Time Out calls it a pub, club and everything in-between.

music.notes: Pop evenings, hip hop sessions and drag cabaret, including KIKI Drag Cabaret on Saturdays, a Saturday drag brunch and resident DJs on Sundays.

crowd: The venue says it is a safe and inclusive space for everyone, with drag shows.

accessibility.notes: Questions about access, disability assistance and carers' tickets for gigs go to the venue.

evidence.quote: Welcome to Queen of Hoxton, a vibrant nightclub and bar in Shoreditch that first opened its doors in 2009.
The Queen of Hoxton – pub, club and everything in-between
our venue honours her legacy with vibrant drag shows and a safe, inclusive space for all
we host everything from pop nights, hip hop jams and drag cabaret shows
with DJs playing on a cutting-edge disco/house tip on the weekends
Every Saturday daytime we serve up the most outrageous brunch in East London: Drag & Waffle Bottomless Brunch.
From 2pm every Sunday, settle in with music from our resident DJs
The capacity of our full venue is 500.
